en: Ah, yes... I don't wish you to misunderstand...

Seances and necromancy are two different
things. Necromancy defiles the dead...
<CLT=cltMIND>Should I hang out with Kiyo for a while?

You wish to hear of the differences?
As I thought, you have an interest in seances.

<CLT=cltMIND>I listened to Kiyo talk endlessly
about seances...
<CLT=cltMIND>Kiyo and I grew a little closer today.
